select p.name as name,
       sum(r.amount_cents) / 100 as deposit_usd
from fin.requests r
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = r.user_ref
where r.status = 2 and r.type = 1
group by p.name;

select p.name,
       sum(r.amount_cents) / 100 as deposit_usd
from fin.requests r
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = r.user_ref
where r.status = 2
  and r.type = 1
group by p.name;

select a.agent_name, count(*) as sessions
from app.sessions s
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = cast(s.playerid as bigint)
join crm.agents a on a.code = p.agent_code
group by a.agent_name;

select t2.agent_name as agent_name, count(*) as sessions
from app.sessions t0
join crm.player_accounts t1 on t1.id = cast(t0.playerid as bigint)
join crm.agents t2 on t2.code = t1.agent_code
group by t2.agent_name;

select g.title,
       sum(b.stake_cents) / 100 as stake_usd
from game.bets b
join game.games g on g.code = b.game_code
group by g.title;

select p.country,

select count(distinct p.id) as players
from crm.player_accounts p
join app.sessions s on p.id = cast(s.playerid as bigint)
join game.bets b on p.id = b.member_ref;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS players
FROM crm.player_accounts p
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.sessions s WHERE CAST(s.playerid AS BIGINT) = p.id)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM game.bets b WHERE b.member_ref = p.id);
